links.outcome: Association of prior AI training with nurses' AI knowledge, attitudes, and perceived challenges
links.effect: Prior AI training was associated with more positive attitudes (p = 0.019) but not with knowledge or perceived challenges (no significant associations).
links.quote: Previous AI-related training was significantly associated with more positive attitudes toward AI (p = 0.019), whereas no significant associations were found with knowledge or perceived challenges.

screen.reason: A cross-sectional survey examining nurses' knowledge, attitudes, and perceived challenges regarding AI in patient care.
